Apollo Reborn issue #1453 simulator evidence
============================================

Commit under test:
  1e900df8d12055addf78cf604709606953e9b0d0

Environment:
  Xcode 27.1 (27A9275)
  iOS 27.1 simulator
  iPhone 16 Pro simulator
  Apollo 3.9.0 with Liquid Glass enabled
  Existing populated authenticated feed

Driver scope:
  Apollo's simulator debug bridge delivered synthetic UIKit touch phases through
  UIApplication. This did not invoke the operating system Home recognizer and was
  not a physical iPhone 17 Pro Max / iOS 27.0.1 reproduction.

Observed checks:

  Before upward Home-like touch:
    selected=0 tabs=5

  Command:
    swipe (205,840) -> (265,650), 20 steps, 10 ms per step

  Apollo log:
    13:36:44.648 [LiquidGlassTabBar] Preserving tab during a vertical or inactive gesture
    13:36:44.858 [SimDebugTap] swipe delivered (205,840)->(265,650) over 20 x 10 ms

  After upward Home-like touch:
    selected=0 tabs=5

  Intentional horizontal command:
    swipe (80,840) -> (300,840), 24 steps, 15 ms per step

  Apollo log:
    13:37:01.701 [SimDebugTap] swipe delivered (80,840)->(300,840) over 24 x 15 ms

  After intentional horizontal touch:
    selected=3 tabs=5

  Separate rapid lifecycle check:
    Posts selected before upward touch: selected=0 tabs=5
    Foregrounded Settings during a two-second held upward touch, then immediately returned
    Apollo returned on Posts: selected=0 tabs=5
    Ordinary Search tap after reactivation: selected=3 tabs=5

Privacy treatment:
  The published GIF is cropped to the bottom tab interaction. Feed text below the
  bar is covered, and the account label is covered and marked "account redacted".
  The raw full-screen recording is not published.
